## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A six-juan Cáodòng Chán *sònggǔ* / *píngchàng* collaborative commentary, X67 n1303. Non-commentary on a single parent Buddhist text; *commentedTextid* omitted.

Yìqīng's 100 *sònggǔ* verses on classical *gōng'àn* cases circulated in the Cáodòng tradition from the late 11th century onward. Cónglún's Yuán-era *píngchàng* commentary — adding running-expository commentary to each case-and-verse — brings the material into the mature Yuán-Cáodòng lineage-teaching form.

**Abstract**

[Tóuzǐ Yìqīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E9%9D%92) 投子義青 (1032–1083/5/29; age 52, per his *yǔlù* juan 2 biographical record). Major Northern-Sòng Cáodòng-lineage master. *Shì* Cíjì 慈濟, *Miàoxù dàshī* 妙續大師. Native of Shūzhōu 舒州 (Ānhuī); nicknamed "Qīng Huáyán" 青華嚴 ("Qīng the Huáyán Specialist"). Dharma-heir of [Dàyáng Jǐngxuán](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%AF%E7%8E%84) 大陽景玄 in the Cáodòng line; abbot of Tóuzǐshān 投子山 in his native Shūzhōu.

[Línquán Cónglún](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E5%80%AB) 林泉從倫 (b. 1223): Yuán Cáodòng-lineage master. *Hào* Línquán 林泉 ("Forest-Spring"), Línquán lǎorén 林泉老人. Also called Bàoēn Cónglún 報恩從倫.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1060 (Yìqīng's original composition of the *sònggǔ*); *notAfter* c. 1290 (Cónglún's productive period for the *píngchàng* — the received form reflects the Yuán Cónglún commentary's completion).
